gaps.required_input: paper task packet, code path, artifact list, and rubric source pointer
gaps.expected_output: source-target list for the missing task and artifact records
gaps.stop_condition: stop at not-found if task, code, artifact, or rubric record cannot be source-locked
gaps.hard_fail: treating a missing task artifact as retrieved or reviewed

gaps.required_input: stable source anchor for bounded subcase limits and review criteria
gaps.expected_output: source anchor or explicit boundary gap
gaps.stop_condition: stop when the bounded-subcase source pointer is recorded or downgraded to gap
gaps.hard_fail: using an unlocked boundary as source-backed

gaps.required_input: artifact review fields, execution checks, and rubric pass/fail mapping
gaps.expected_output: planned artifact-review rule template that remains non-executable until source-locked
gaps.stop_condition: stop after a planned rule template is emitted with missing source fields visible
gaps.hard_fail: treating rubric review as a completed workflow result

cases.boundary: specific lab-scale material-system reproducibility action only

gaps.expected_output: protocol completion request tied to the specific reproducibility case
gaps.stop_condition: stop with partial protocol visible if required variables are absent
gaps.hard_fail: describing partial protocol variables as complete

gaps.required_input: comparator cells, local assembly variation, and expected control behavior
gaps.expected_output: baseline/control completion request for the reproducibility lead
gaps.stop_condition: stop when the missing comparator or control state is recorded
gaps.hard_fail: claiming controlled comparative support without the comparator

gaps.required_input: independent group evidence, interlaboratory status, and reporting recommendation source anchors
gaps.expected_output: validation-status check that preserves partial or not-found outcomes
gaps.stop_condition: stop after interlaboratory source status is recorded without changing evidence state
gaps.hard_fail: writing planned or partial validation as reproduced validation

gaps.required_input: required evidence objects and forbidden inference paths for ASSB reproducibility
gaps.expected_output: domain contract update for protocol, observables, reporting gates, and blocked inferences
